description: This file defines a buffer data structure and associated functions for managing dynamic string and binary data buffers in C. It includes buffer creation, manipulation, and utility functions, as well as inline implementations for common buffer operations.

methods.name: buffer_init
methods.description: Creates and returns a new empty buffer or a copy of given data.

methods.name: buffer_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for the buffer.

methods.name: buffer_move
methods.description: Moves content from source buffer to destination buffer, resetting source.

methods.name: buffer_string_prepare_copy
methods.description: Prepares buffer to store a string of specified size, resetting old content.

methods.name: buffer_string_prepare_append
methods.description: Prepares buffer to append a string of specified size, preserving existing data.

methods.name: buffer_extend
methods.description: Extends buffer for immediate addition of bytes, returning pointer for writing.

methods.name: buffer_commit
methods.description: Increases buffer length after writing data, updating the null terminator.

methods.name: buffer_clear
methods.description: Invalidates buffer contents without freeing memory.

methods.name: buffer_reset
methods.description: Invalidates buffer contents and frees larger buffers for reuse.

methods.name: buffer_free_ptr
methods.description: Frees buffer pointer and resets buffer.

methods.name: buffer_copy_string
methods.description: Copies a null-terminated string into the buffer.

methods.name: buffer_copy_string_len
methods.description: Copies a string of specified length into the buffer.

methods.name: buffer_append_string
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated string to the buffer.

methods.name: buffer_append_string_len
methods.description: Appends a string of specified length to the buffer.

methods.name: buffer_append_str2
methods.description: Appends two strings with specified lengths to the buffer.

methods.name: buffer_append_str3
methods.description: Appends three strings with specified lengths to the buffer.

methods.name: buffer_append_uint_hex_lc
methods.description: Appends an unsigned integer as lowercase hex string.

methods.name: buffer_append_int
methods.description: Appends an integer value as string.

methods.name: buffer_append_strftime
methods.description: Appends formatted date/time string based on format and tm struct.

methods.name: li_itostrn
methods.description: Converts integer to string with specified buffer length.

methods.name: li_utostrn
methods.description: Converts unsigned integer to string with specified buffer length.

methods.name: li_tohex_lc
methods.description: Converts binary data to lowercase hex string.

methods.name: li_tohex_uc
methods.description: Converts binary data to uppercase hex string.

methods.name: buffer_eq_icase_ssn
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison of specified length.

methods.name: buffer_eq_icase_ss
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison of two strings.

methods.name: buffer_eq_icase_slen
methods.description: Case-insensitive comparison of buffer and string.

methods.name: buffer_eq_slen
methods.description: Comparison of buffer and string with length.

methods.name: buffer_is_equal
methods.description: Checks if two buffers are equal.

methods.name: buffer_substr_replace
methods.description: Replaces a substring within the buffer.

methods.name: buffer_append_string_encoded_hex_lc
methods.description: Appends hex-encoded string in lowercase.

methods.name: buffer_append_string_encoded_hex_uc
methods.description: Appends hex-encoded string in uppercase.

methods.name: buffer_append_string_encoded
methods.description: Appends encoded string based on encoding type.

methods.name: buffer_append_string_c_escaped
methods.description: Escapes non-printable characters in string.

methods.name: buffer_append_bs_escaped
methods.description: Escapes backslash and control characters.

methods.name: buffer_append_bs_escaped_json
methods.description: Escapes string for JSON.

methods.name: buffer_urldecode_path
methods.description: Decodes URL-encoded path.

methods.name: buffer_is_valid_UTF8
methods.description: Checks if buffer contains valid UTF-8.

methods.name: buffer_path_simplify
methods.description: Simplifies file path in buffer.

methods.name: buffer_to_lower
methods.description: Converts buffer string to lowercase.

methods.name: buffer_to_upper
methods.description: Converts buffer string to uppercase.

methods.name: hex2int
methods.description: Converts a hex character to integer.

methods.name: li_hex2bin
methods.description: Converts hex string to binary data.
